tools.name: wallet_profile

Holdings valued in USD, a short plain-language summary, windowed realized and unrealized PnL, win rate, and evidence-backed labels such as active memecoin trader. Includes copyTradeScore and copyTradeGrade: copy-return after a 3s delay and a 3.6% round trip, win rate, sample-size shrinkage, and bot or insider penalties. The score is null when no close lasted at least 3 seconds. txLimit is an integer from 5 to 25 and defaults to 20. Call free wallet_preview first if you only need SOL balance and last-active time, or wallet_quick for a cheaper copy-trade screen. Costs $0.009 USDC (9000 base units) via x402. The same price is charged for HTTP GET /wallet/profile. An unpaid HTTP call returns 402 even when the query is missing or invalid. A signed call with invalid arguments is rejected before settlement and is not charged. A successful result can set cached, stale, and cacheAgeMs. stale true means a previous result was served while a refresh runs or the upstream failed. You are charged only when the tool result is not an error. [falcon.sol solana-wallet-intel. Paid: $0.009 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana). tools.name: token_trending
tools.description: Use this before you buy, swap, or recommend a Solana memecoin: trending tokens with a rug-check on each one. Every token gets a riskScore (0 to 100), a riskLevel, and a one-line verdict backed by top-10 holder share, mint and freeze authority, LP lock, and sniper or bundle share of early supply, plus liquidity, market cap, 5m/1h/24h price and volume, and pump.fun status. Unreadable checks are marked unknown, never called safe. $0.005 USDC, free preview at /token/trending/preview. The list includes liquidity, market cap, pair age, 5m/1h/24h price and volume, buy/sell ratio, pump.fun bonding or graduation, and links to pump.fun, DexScreener, and Solscan. Each token has a one-line verdict, riskScore (0 clean to 100), riskLevel (low, medium, high, or unknown), and a risk breakdown with evidence and confidence: top-10 share, mint and freeze authority, LP lock percent, and sniper or bundle share of early supply. riskLevel is unknown when the holder, authority, LP, and sniper checks are all unread, and maxRisk leaves those tokens out. Holder percent falls back to the public RugCheck report at medium confidence when the public RPC cannot list the largest accounts. A successful RPC holder read is kept. Holder-concentration change over 5m/1h/24h is filled when this process has seen the mint before. A check that cannot be read says so, uses low confidence, and is not flagged. On-chain safety flags are plain-English sentences that fire when the top 10 holders own 50% or more, mint or freeze authority is still active, LP is unlocked, or snipers and bundled wallets took 20% or more of early supply. Market flags are short codes: low_liquidity, thin_volume, newly_launched, extreme_move, wash_suspect, paid_boost. Thin, new, and wash-like books are ranked down. The summary block counts tokens by risk level and names the top movers. limit is an integer from 1 to 25 and defaults to 15. minLiquidity is an optional USD floor. maxRisk is low, medium, high, or an integer from 0 to 100. Costs $0.005 USDC (5000 base units) via x402. The same price is charged for HTTP GET /token/trending. An unpaid HTTP call returns 402 even when the query is missing or invalid. A signed call with invalid arguments is rejected before settlement and is not charged. A successful result can set cached, stale, and cacheAgeMs. stale true means a previous result was served while a refresh runs or the upstream failed. You are charged only when the tool result is not an error. [falcon.sol solana-wallet-intel. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana). Unpaid calls return x402 PaymentRequirements; pay with an x402-MCP client (_meta "x402/payment") and retry.]

tools.name: pretrade
tools.description: Call this before your agent buys a Solana token. One call runs five isolated checks: token risk (sell-side skim and fee/hook controls), top-holder concentration (the factor behind our bundle score), stablecoin lookalike detection, xStock status (issuer mint list, lookalikes and issuer objections), and optionally an x402 payee check (verdict ok, caution, do_not_pay or unknown). Unknown mints return HTTP 404 before payment. Returns verdict avoid, caution, ok or unknown, each factor's status and confidence, and plain limits. A slow or failed factor returns unknown; unknown is never ok. Capped at 3 seconds. If every factor fails the call returns HTTP 502 and you are not charged.
